148:t_001:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As proof, I'm here on the front line myself to bring this operation to a close.」

148:t_001:17.en:
$n
「You don't get to decide that $$新日本$$ is finished!」

148:t_001:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「We won't let you do that as long as we're here!」

148:t_001:19.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Splendid! You won't lose your fighting spirit, even with defeat certain! That's what I'd expect of Earthlings!」

148:t_001:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You already know, don't you? This country's spirit is broken. It's finished.」

148:t_001:22.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's why we'll win, to keep hope alive!」

148:t_001:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If we beat you, the commander, we can turn things around! I'll make you regret showing your face!」

148:t_001:24.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... I meant to use that speech to demand your surrender. It seems to have had the opposite effect.」

148:t_001:25.en:
$$ギルター$$
「General $$サルディアス$$! Give the attack order, now!」

148:t_001:26.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Yes, yes, $$ギルター$$. You're eager to redeem yourself too, aren't you?」

148:t_001:27.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I thoroughly approve of fighting with hatred like that.」

148:t_001:28.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(His confidence isn't just a bluff...)

148:t_001:29.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now, the moment you've been waiting for... Let's begin the attack!」

148:t_001:30.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Today, we'll bring $$トウキョウ$$ and $$新日本$$ to an end. Give it your all, everyone!」

148:t_002:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, this is quite a predicament. I never expected this result...」

148:t_003:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, this is quite a predicament. I didn't expect you to hold out this long.」

148:t_004:1.en:
$n
「We have to defeat him here, at least!」

148:t_005:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The unease I've felt all this time... One of its causes is...!」

148:t_006:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even if you can sense me, you can't escape this needle.」

148:t_007:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That will only make you suffer longer.」

148:t_008:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That's right, 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》.」

148:t_008:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now... This time, let your own hatred consume you.」

148:t_008:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「While the $$いがみ合う双子$$ writhes in hatred, I'll introduce myself.」

148:t_008:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My name is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

148:t_008:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the '$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$'.」

148:t_008:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're the $$リアクター$$ $n encountered!」

148:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Resentment... So it draws its power from hatred...!」

148:t_008:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I heard you'd taken the $$スフィア$$ from $$ガドライト#pilot$$, so I was looking forward to seeing what you could do...」

148:t_008:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What a disappointment. Just as $$尸空#pilot$$ said, even that drunk was better than this.」

148:t_008:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So you can still keep your sanity... Persistence is a trait of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.」

148:t_008:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My $$アン・アーレス$$'s venom is effective, isn't it? You and your ugly machine are finished now.」

148:t_008:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Too bad! I won't let you interfere with the boss!」

148:t_009:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We can't get through to rescue him...!」

148:t_009:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Your name was $n, wasn't it...? I'll ask you just once.」

148:t_009:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Join $$サイデリアル$$. That $$スフィア$$ wasn't yours to begin with.」

148:t_009:5.en:
$n
「I... refuse... Why would I... join... invaders...?」

148:t_010:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「He's launching that attack again!」

148:t_010:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「All the $$スフィア$$s will come together...」

148:t_011:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, concentrate your fire on $$バルビエル$$!」

148:t_012:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You wretches who escaped death...!」

148:t_014:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Whoa! I won't let you get near our $$リアクター$$!」

148:t_015:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Tch! Have I reached the $$リ・ガズィ$$'s limits?!」

148:t_015:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$刹那$$, $$ロックオン$$! Get that to Captain $$アムロ$$!」
